Wakefin

A great black fish of the open sea, known to the Saltwrights by its blade of a fin and the bright wake it cuts. It circles a hull before it strikes, and it dives at the sound of singing. Hollowmere's crews sing anyway.
Keep watch through the night. No lamps.
Liss's father keeps the dry-dock berths.
At dusk, the pyre-raft.
A ship is waiting to carry you south.
The dock-master has set out bowls.
A current-singer at a bow is humming something low.
Toma wants to see the tally hull.
In the dark, listen. The timeline still shows what it means to do.
Sea-Glow Scale
A black scale that gives off a faint green light when it's wet. Used in Customize.
Current Broth
Hollowmere fish broth, ladled out to whoever is on deck. Everyone gets a bowl.
Hull-Iron Cleaver
A cleaver forged from a Saltwright keel-plate. The wright who made it asked nothing for it.
Tide-Wheel Launcher
A launcher geared like a tide-wheel, Hollowmere-built. Tobin drew the first plan for it.
Current Harness
A Saltwright tether harness, patched and lent. You give it back at the end of the voyage.
Hollowmere Boat-Pike
A long boat-pike for fending off hulls. No Order mark on it anywhere.
